messages:
Maya (PM): quick sync 1: legal asked for per-tenant retention windows + an admin/legal-hold override. customers asking for chain-of-custody exports too. can we scope a V1 for the next quarter?
Zane (Eng): got it. We should decide model: tenant-level TTL that applies to audit_events and message artifacts. legal_hold should flip a flag that prevents deletions. implications on GC and indexing though.
Priya (Security): legal_hold must be auditable and append-only: who set it, when, reason, ticket id. also store integrity hashes for evidence items and signed manifests for exports. BYOK affects export key handling.
Liam (Legal): retention offerings: presets 90d / 1y / 7y plus custom up to 10y. exports must include manifest with timestamps and signatures. legal team needs an admin workflow to place/release holds (with justification).
Nora (Ops): runbook: retention job should skip held tenants and emit metrics for hold_count and skipped_bytes. paging policy when long-running exports start. emergency release flow must be strict.
Zane (Eng): initial API sketch:
PUT /v1/tenants/:id/retention
{ "default_ttl_days": 365, "max_ttl_days": 3650, "auto_purge": true }
POST /v1/tenants/:id/legal_hold
{ "actor": "user@customer.com", "reason": "litigation", "ticket": "T-1234" }
DELETE /v1/tenants/:id/legal_hold  # releases hold (audit logged)
Maya (PM): good. minimal GA acceptance?
Priya (Security): must include: immutable audit trail for hold actions, KMS-wrapped export keys (support BYOK later), retention backlog traces proving enforcement, and test coverage for bypass attempts. map to SOC2 evidence for logging and retention.
Zane (Eng): proposed milestones:
M1 (MVP): tenant TTL enforcement (no UI), legal_hold flag persisted, retention job respects holds, export endpoint that returns signed manifest.
M2: tenant UI + admin controls, signed export bundles, KMS/BYOK glue for wrap/unwrap, ops alerts.
M3: cross-region consistency, archive tiering, key rotation for exported bundles.
Liam (Legal): acceptance checklist: 1) cannot delete while hold active; 2) export within SLA; 3) manifest proves chain-of-custody.
Nora (Ops): ops checklist: dashboard rows for holds, retention job idempotency checks, manual intervention runbook, contact list for key-escrow requests.
Maya (PM): prioritization: two enterprise pilots and SOC2 renewals push this up. recommendation: ship M1 by sprint 6, M2 by sprint 11.
Zane (Eng): tradeoffs: retention increases storage/cost; per-tenant indexing/partitioning needed; legal_hold adds lifetime storage. We'll include cost delta and capacity plan.
Priya (Security): BYOK notes: exports should use ephemeral data keys encrypted by customer KMS. we should avoid storing plaintext longer than necessary. define escrow policy for legal requests.
Maya (PM): action items: Zane prototype DB schema + retention job changes by EOD Fri; Priya draft security/BYOK checklist; Nora draft ops runbook stub; Liam confirm manifest fields + SLA.
deploy-bot: Heads-up: retention-job-v2 scheduled deploy 2026-03-15T02:00Z on branch retention/tenant-holds.
Nora (Ops): flagging that deploy needs hold until legal_hold persistence & audits are validated.
Maya (PM): agreed. will consolidate into spec doc tomorrow and circulate for review. thanks all. :+1:
